subject: Staged commit & extension paths: 12m vs 18m prepay options
messages:
From: Lia Cho <lia.cho@foundrylab.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tyler Brooks <tyler.brooks@foundrylab.ai>
Date: 2026-01-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Options for 12-24 month prepay / ramped minimums

Hi Karthik,

We're evaluating Redwood for our copilots roadmap and need pricing options that align with startup runway constraints. Our internal forecast shows spend ~ $3k/mo initial, potentially rising to $18-22k/mo over 12-18 months after launch. Procurement wants clear alternatives we can compare quickly.

Could you sketch two concise packages: a 12-month annual prepay (simple, lower term discount) and an 18-month staged-commit (higher term discount but ramped minimums). We care about:
- how ramp milestones are defined and enforced,
- mechanics for top-ups/credits mid-term,
- termination / refund rules, and
- whether an onboarding credit is possible instead of a deeper term discount.

Short bullets + a draft SOW would be ideal. Tyler and I have limited windows for a call next week (Tue/Thu mornings).

Thanks,
Lia Cho
Head of Product, Foundry Labs
[Attachment: Foundry_usage_estimates.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lia Cho <lia.cho@foundrylab.ai>
Cc: Tyler Brooks <tyler.brooks@foundrylab.ai>
Date: 2026-01-16T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Options for 12-24 month prepay / ramped minimums

Hi Lia / Tyler,

Appreciate the context. Attached is a short pricing sheet with two starter proposals and a toy model mapped to your forecast:

Package A - 12-month annual prepay:
- 10% term discount off list on prepay amount.
- Credits applied monthly; overage billed at 100% list but preceded by top-ups at the discounted rate.
- Cancellation: pro-rated refund after month 6 with 30-day notice; otherwise no refund.
- Auto-renew opt-in; 80% usage by month 10 triggers optional renewal credit.

Package B - 18-month staged-commit:
- 18% term discount on total prepay if staged ramp schedule met.
- Ramp proposal (example): Q1 = 25% of annual run-rate, Q2-Q3 = 50%, Q4+ = 100%.
- Overage: billed monthly at 60% of list after credits; quarterly true-up.
- One-time onboarding credit available ($5k) instead of deeper initial discount.

If helpful, I can revise the ramp cadence to be more conservative (lower Q1) — happy to build both the 12m and 18m DocuSign packages. Can we do Wed 01/21 10:00am PT for a 30-min walkthrough?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing-sheet-foundry-2026.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-19T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Foundry Labs - early-stage prepay options

Marissa / Vivek,

Forwarding Foundry's ask and my starter sheet. Quick summary of what I proposed and open points for ops/legal:
- 12m: 10% discount, simple monthly credit drawdown, limited pro-rated refund window.
- 18m staged: 18% term discount but requires ramp milestones; overage at reduced rate and onboarding credit optional.

Open items to confirm internally: acceptable discount bands for < $250k total prepay, conservative ramp schedule for seed/Series A profiles, margins on overage bands, and refund language (legal will prefer minimal refunds).

Any preference between: (a) reduce 18% -> 16% and offer $5k onboarding credit, or (b) keep 18% and no onboarding credit? Also advise on changing Q1 ramp to 15-20% for cash-sensitive customers.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-21T14:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Foundry Labs - early-stage prepay options

Karthik - good framing. My suggested commercial guardrails for this cohort: 
1) 12m prepay = 10% term discount (keep simple).
2) 18m staged-commit = 16% discount with a smoother ramp: Q1=20%, Q2=40%, Q3=80%, Q4+=100%.
3) Overage capped functionally at 75% list to limit downside; allow quarterly reconciliation to true-up usage vs commit.
4) Offer $5k onboarding credit applied month 1 (helps get signal & reduces sticker shock).
5) Refunds: only pro-rated after month 12 on multi-year deals and 60-day termination notice.

I'll attach SOW boilerplate and can route to legal for a quick redline once Karthik confirms the numbers.

-Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SOW_foundry_draft.pdf (PDF, 72KB)]

Subject: Re: Staged commit & extension paths: 12m vs 18m prepay options

Karthik / Marissa - thanks, this is very helpful. Procurement has two small asks before sign: 
1) Could Q1 be 15% instead of 20% to help cash flow? (we can accelerate if usage materializes)
2) We need a clear top-up mechanism: ability to buy additional credits mid-term at the same discounted rate, applied immediately.
3) For the 12m option, include an automatic extension clause: if Foundry reaches >=80% of committed usage by month 10, the contract auto-renews for another 12 months at the same effective rate unless either party opts out with 30 days notice.

If you can produce two DocuSign-ready packages reflecting these tweaks we can move to signature this week.

-Lia

Lia / Tyler - appreciate the clear asks. Attached are two finalized packages for signature:

Package 1 (12-month):
- 10% term discount, credits applied monthly, top-ups allowed at discounted rate.
- Auto-extension clause: if usage >= 80% of commit by month 10, automatic 12m renewal at same rates unless opt-out within 30 days.
- Cancellation: pro-rated refund only if terminated after month 6 with 30-day notice.

Package 2 (18-month staged-commit):
- 16% term discount, ramp = 15% (Q1), 40% (Q2), 80% (Q3), 100% (Q4+), $5k onboarding credit applied month 1.
- Overage billed monthly at 75% of list; quarterly true-up protection.
- Pro-rated refund available after month 12 with 60-day termination notice.
